verdicts.a-74: CITABLE ONLY WITH A STATED SENTENCE (a census: steps 2, 4, 5 do not apply; through-the-target blocks test NOT RUN). Re-counted by this run's own loop over poll_log (181,936 rows, mode=ro, read closed at the last poll, 2026-10-08 23:17Z): 10 gaps over 300 s, 244.5 min down of 42,986, 99.43% up, longest 84.4 min from 2026-09-15 02:18Z - equal to a-74's find_gaps/window_uptime on the same rows and to its report. a-67's 83.8-minute outage (10-06 03:24Z) and a-65's 37.7-minute one (10-04 14:50Z) are each a gap of that length. Plants on a-74's functions: an hour of polls removed is found; the same hour present with ok=0 (a live process recording failures) reads as a gap; a poll every 60 s shows none. Sentence: 'Poll-gap uptime over any venue and any endpoint. It is not process liveness and it is not capture: one venue silent for 180 minutes while another polls reads 100% up (planted). On the record to 2026-10-08 that hid little - outside the ten gaps, Kalshi was silent for more than 15 minutes for 9.4 minutes in total and Polymarket for 0.2 - and five of the ten gaps are 5.1-5.2 minute cadence jitter that still count as down. Whether quotes were written while up was not measured.' The exported file carries the definition; summary()'s log line prints the percentage with none. Scope: NFL logger, 2026-09-09 to 2026-10-08. Power: not applicable.

'SIXTEEN OF SIXTEEN' IS NOT EVIDENCE: 6 are gated to published values, the 4 ordering contrasts cannot fail even at worst-case SE once that gate passes, so the registered success rule could not have returned failure; 2 of 16 were open and neither is in the rule. Sentence: 'Margin-of-victory Elo against settlement and three naive baselines, not a price (it loses to every price in both sports): NFL 2001-2025, 6,743 games; college FBS-FBS 2005-2025, 15,508. The raw college-minus-NFL gap is not a same-strength comparison. At equal forecast strength it is -0.0028 [-0.0071, +0.0012] against home (0.46 of its MDE: a null this population cannot resolve, not a measured zero), -0.0073 [-0.0115, -0.0029] against record (1.21x, at the bar) and -0.0032 [-0.0046, -0.0018] against plain Elo (1.57x). The raw plain-Elo difference -0.0015 (0.89 of its MDE) passes Holm only as the family's last step, at its unadjusted p 0.012, and fails Bonferroni over 16.' THE ORDERING/SIZE CLAIM IS NOT STATED AT EQUAL FORECAST STRENGTH EVERYWHERE: bare at docs/findings/cross-sport.md:54 ('larger in college on every baseline, on both scales' - no re-weighted skill-scale figure exists at all), in the head sentence of its CLAUDE.md entry (:1990-1992; the re-weighted figure follows as a sub-bullet) and in the relay findings[0]; CLAUDE.md:1994 words the under-powered home null as 'not a better model'.
verdicts.c-41: CITABLE ONLY WITH A STATED SENTENCE (a null). The target's script re-run today (mode=ro, 63 s): all 46 tests equal the committed result, 0 of 6 pass, team implied total +0.0148 [+0.0048, +0.0242] Holm p 0.12, intercept arm -0.00047 [-0.00074, -0.00019]; 18,666 rungs, 10,016 player-games, 814 games counted here. Blocks THROUGH M.coef_test / M.brier_test with M.block_weights: honours_blocks on three statistics (x1.000 in block, x0.44-0.48 as new blocks); player, season-week and team-season blocks change no sign. THE FAMILY TRIED IS THE FAMILY REGISTERED: 42 registered + 4 descriptive = 46; the pass rule's 'realized MDE' wording is in the registration at de5a5a7, the script is unchanged after the run, no second result file. Leakage: function-level with planted leaks RUN; a store-level scramble of build() NOT RUN; team total's untimestamped input not checked. THE STATED POWER DOES NOT HOLD: a synthetic candidate through the target's own analyse + verdict on the real rows passes 0% at no effect, 3% at 0.0148, 9% at 0.020, 41% at 0.033, 68% at 0.040 and 82-85% at 0.045-0.050 (80 reps; re-drawn by the run at 30 reps: 37% and 90%). The rule can pass, so the null is not vacuous, but 'binds at 0.033' is its coin-flip point. Sentence: 'NFL receiving-yards overs, regular season 2023-2025, against the de-vigged DK/FD/MGM price about 14 minutes before kickoff: none of six pre-registered LINEAR candidates passed the registered rule. That rule detects a true, season-stable effect 80% of the time only near 4.5-5 points of over probability per sd, not 2; 0.02 is inside the 95% interval of team implied total (to +0.0242) and of line position (to -0.0232). Team implied total is unresolved, not refuted: its Brier gain (0.000140) is what a true effect of its own size produces (0.000146), and the rule passes that 3% of the time.' Power: nearest miss 1.05 (coefficient) and 0.996 (Brier) of MDE; intercept arm 1.16, Bonferroni p 0.048 over 42 and 0.053 over 46. Says nothing about other markets, the open, non-linear effects or efficiency.
verdicts.c-40: CITABLE ONLY WITH A STATED SENTENCE. From c-40's committed rows (the 890 s pipeline NOT re-run; the flip values are taken as committed; NO leakage step): all 80 tests recomputed through the target's slice_tests at its seed equal the committed result; 150 of 227 missed (66.1%), 170 of 250 cleared (68.0%), T2 -0.019 [-0.099, +0.067], 31 games, weeks 3-4. Blocks THROUGH counterfactual_ledger.slice_tests: honours_blocks for T1 and T2 (x1.000 in block, x0.46 as new blocks); week blocks (2) NOT READ; player, player-game and team blocks change nothing. NOTHING IN IT SURVIVES AS A STATEMENT ABOUT MISSES: own_mean is the flipping input on 67.1% of all 477 leans whatever the outcome, and with the missed/cleared label permuted within game 66.1% sits at the 62nd percentile of its null (permutation p 0.75; re-drawn independently by the run: 0.74). 'Holm p 2e-19' rejects a 1/5 null the model's structure violates on its own. Sentence: 'NFL 2026 weeks 3-4, Board ledger snapshot of 2026-10-08T20:16Z, 477 of 496 graded player-prop leans, 31 games, proportional-distance scale only: the player's own prior mean is the nearest flipping input on 67% of leans whatever the outcome. As a statement about misses it is a null at 0.16 of its MDE (0.12): a difference under about 0.12 in share would not have been seen, a week-block interval cannot be read at two weeks, and the 19 excluded leans (all week 4, 13 missed, Fisher p 0.10) could move it only within [-0.062, +0.015].' Never cite the 66.1% without the 68.0%. Two executions on byte-identical rows (27 Holm survivors before the zero-variance fix, 8 after; same estimates and verdict), disclosed by the unit. Worded past the evidence: findings :24 'No input is over-represented among the misses' and its CLAUDE.md entry 'on misses and clears alike' carry no MDE.

verdicts.c-34: CITABLE ONLY WITH A STATED SENTENCE (a null). Pipeline re-run on today's store: all 9,418 arm 1 and arm 3 forecasts equal the unit's; dDSC +0.00010 [-0.00022, +0.00040] and +0.00002 [-0.00017, +0.00019], dMCB and dAUC reproduce through rc.Pop.boot. Blocks THROUGH research.ranking_calibration.Pop.boot (season-week blocks, 36 units): honours_blocks on four statistics; CORP is refit inside every draw. Leakage RUN: 11,207 injury rows behind 1,073 scored team-games, none stamped at or after kickoff (minimum lead 1.68 h), a planted late row is refused; scrambling season >= 2024 moves 0 of 4,509 forecasts for 2023 and a planted leaky fit moves 1,460-1,607. NOT RUN: the c-24 baseline ledger's own leakage, the honesty of upstream date_modified. 'TIGHT' DOES NOT SURVIVE (post hoc, the attacker's): the arms move 32% / 36% of forecasts by a median 0.03 / 0.02, and replacing those rows with the close's own price would raise DSC by +0.0006, about 15% of the 0.0041 gap - which this test detects barely for arm 1 and not for arm 3. An in-sample fit is not detected either. Sentence: 'NFL receptions and rush attempts, over side, 9,418 P1 rows of the 2023-24 regular season (36 weeks, 542 games) against the de-vigged DK/FD/MGM close on main lines: adding the injury report changed resolution by 0.23 and 0.07 of the MDEs (0.00044, 0.00026). It is a null on a perturbation that could not have closed the gap, not a tight null on the gap. Only arm 3's fall in miscalibration (-0.0014 [-0.0021, -0.0008]) survives correction; arm 1's (z -1.97, p 0.048) does not survive over 2, 36 or 47 and contains zero under player blocks. Nothing here covers 2025, the depth chart or the open.' Worded past the evidence: findings :45-48 ('a tight one ... would have been seen'), :249-250 ('the market has already used everything public', unlabelled) and the relay findings[0].
verdicts.c-33: CITABLE ONLY WITH A STATED SENTENCE, and the two halves differ. From the unit's archived extract (a store re-run NOT RUN on purpose: the 2026 rows have pruned to a later window): 1,116 of 1,116 est/lo/hi values equal its result, including 2.81 [2.15, 3.60], 2.57, 2.31 and -0.4762. No leakage scramble applies (no forecast); both movement reads are pre-kickoff by read time and book timestamp. THE CLASS CONTRAST IS CITABLE: 'US books returned by The Odds API (us region, no Pinnacle), NFL: about 2pp more hold on player props than on game lines and about 1.1pp more disagreement between books (2026 weeks 3-4, 32 games, 8 keys; 2023-25 closes, 855 games), z 6 to 288, surviving Bonferroni over all 372 computed intervals. It describes book behaviour, not mispricing.' THE RUSH-YARDS HEADLINE MUST TRAVEL WITH: '2026 weeks 3-4, 32 games, under a line-to-probability slope chosen after a smoke run. Under the registered slope the same key reads 0.73pp and ranks 6th of 8; under other defensible slopes 2.1-2.5pp. Yards keys are top-2 under every post-hoc slope (99% of draws) but rush and receiving yards are not ordered (rush first in 69%), and the 2026 yards-minus-count differences sit at their MDE (0.81-1.16).' The slope's sampling uncertainty the unit worried about is immaterial (x1.05); the choice of slope is what moves the number. NOT CITABLE as evidence: Spearman -0.48 over 8 keys (exact permutation p 0.24; +0.74 under the registered slope), so 'the proxies do not agree' is a product of the addendum. The 2023-25 'receiving yards above receptions' (3.9x MDE) holds only for a slope above 0.344 and uses one borrowed from 2026.
